summary: Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its operating partnership agreed to sell a portfolio of 22 industrial properties to an affiliate of EQT Real Estate for approximately $1.2 billion in cash. The transaction, governed by a purchase and sale agreement, is expected to close by September 30, 2026, with no due diligence condition but subject to customary closing conditions, including tenant estoppels. The PSA includes customary reps, warranties, and post-closing obligations. The full agreement will be filed with the Q3 10-Q. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions; the risk-arb angle is the relatively short timeline to completion.
